_comment: GPU session 10 (round 13): the samurai draw in three guards, bullet time from a recorded still, the moves re-built (through object, pedestal down, vertigo, arcs) and eight new showcase takes (crane down, helicopter, FPV, robot arm, reveal, overhead, push-in and a spoken static in Spanish). Casts are copied from round 11 word for word so the faces stay the same. Blocks run by name prefix with --only.

casts.name: Mara
casts.description: a woman in her late twenties with short dark hair, freckles and a yellow rain jacket

casts.name: Oskar
casts.description: an elderly man with a white beard, weathered skin and a navy knit cap

casts.name: Ines
casts.description: a young woman with long curly auburn hair, round glasses and a mustard cardigan

casts.name: Noor
casts.description: a woman in her thirties with dark skin, cropped silver-grey hair, round glasses and a red wool coat

casts.name: Tomas
casts.description: a broad-shouldered man in his forties with a trimmed grey beard, a scar through one eyebrow and a white chef's jacket

takes.name: r13-a1-draw-high-613
takes.subject: Tomas in black samurai armour stands in the pouring rain on a neon-lit Tokyo street at night, the katana sheathed in a black scabbard at his left hip, his right hand resting on its hilt, steam rising from the drains
takes.audio: heavy rain, the long slow scrape of steel as the blade slides out, a low taiko drum hit as he settles into his guard
takes.action: Slowly, over about three seconds, he draws the katana from the scabbard at his left hip, the blade sliding out inch by inch, then lifts it into a high guard beside his right shoulder, the blade pointing up and back, clear of his face, and holds still as rain beads on the steel.
